## Requirements (from the contract)

1. `v_transparency_run` (`ingest_run ⋈ ingest_run_completion ⋈
   ingest_run_report`) + `v_transparency_capture` (`ingest_run_capture
   ⋈ evidence_capture`) — explicit columns, no `SELECT *`,
   `sig_export`-only grants (J3 §3.1 + §3.3 items 1–2); every column
   named in `policy.transparency`'s allow-lists.
2. `runs.jsonl` — one scrubbed `sig.run-record/1` row per execution:
   outcome + times + duration (C-13 keyed: `started` = own
   `started_at` else `finished_at − duration`; code identity only
   where the execution owns its run, else `not_recorded (shared
   run)`), fetches/records, claims counts (`not_recorded` on
   backfilled rows predating the fields), rejected counts by reason
   class, error classes, robots per-host outcome counts (disregard =
   host + count + GL-GATE-08 only), `quota_reached`/`budget_reached`,
   link/clock basis.
3. `captures.jsonl` — one `sig.capture-record/1` row per mark:
   classification, served storage tier (never assumed `public`),
   bytes, digest, retained status, `changed_vs_prior`; a sealed tier
   emits `target: "sealed"` — no locator.
4. `issues.jsonl` — the auto J3 §7.3 classes with
   `opened_at`/`last_seen_at`/`closed_at` + counts; append-only;
   closed vocabulary enforced at emit.
5. `freshness.jsonl` — the cadence rule (release-bound; never a
   next-run stamp — K9 C-4), the shared `freshness_state` inputs incl.
   `one_time_load` + `run_record_missing` (C-7), the two change
   columns (C-6), volatility-now/staleness-typed (C-5),
   `evaluated_at` = the release as-of.
6. Tests — view-column allow-list closure; fixture execution renders
   the C-13 keyed row; shared-run values never presented as the
   execution's; `zero_records`/`never_run` fire; disregard renders
   host+count+GL-GATE-08 only; a sealed capture stays sealed; `+0`
   re-export byte-stable.
7. Stamps — `SIG-TRANSP-006` (also) + the cited ids, in
   `pr/P35.33.md`.

## Self-review / gap analysis (closing)

- **One publication boundary** — the views carry only allow-listed
  columns to `sig_export`; `explicit_columns` refuses a
  never-exported name at emission; the record field lists are their
  own allow-lists — three closures, each test-pinned.
- **Execution-keyed honesty** — `execution_id` is the report's own
  id; shared-run values are labelled absent, never borrowed; the
  fallback clock names its basis.
- **Two clocks** — `evaluated_at` pins every freshness value to the
  release as-of; the cadence rule is a fact, the "next run" belongs
  to the status lane and appears nowhere here.
- **Known limits recorded, not smoothed** — `last_upstream_change` is
  digest-derived (byte-only changes understate real change — the
  basis says so); `last_sig_records_change` is `first_release` until
  a second release exists; the lane map is `unknown`/`not_recorded`
  until row 313 (`D-P35.31-1`); `scheduler_drift` is plumbed with no
  producer; volatility is interim over the predicate registry
  (P35.41 refines); `records`-digest-based content change waits
  P35.41 (the `changed_vs_prior` field's honest basis documents it).
- **Pushed heads verbatim** — `52122eb9` (impl) → `872b71de` (PR
  body) → `ccbb6a1c` (changelog — **5/5 green head-bound**, run
  39227760200); the closeout commit carries this record's final
  lines + the index/LEDGER/README rows.
